activeHookFor(uint256).details: EIP-712 typed-data hashing and signer recovery for the keeper      `commitEvolution` flow are delegated to {AgentCollectionEIP712}.

mintAgentWithFullStack(string,string,byt.details: For the service leg to land:           - `linkedX402Receiver` must be set (creator-only setter)           - the collection must have been onboarded via             {AgentX402Receiver.selfRegisterCollection}           - all of (serviceId, token, price) must be non-zero         If any precondition fails, the mint still succeeds and the         service leg is silently skipped — matches the additive         semantics of {AgentIdentityRegistry.mintWithFullStack}.

params.agentURI: Metadata URI (empty ⇒ generative path uses                    `collectionBaseURI + tokenId + .json`).
params.serviceId: bytes32(0) to skip the service leg.
params.tbaSalt: Reserved for a future collection-side TBA wiring                    leg. Currently unused.
params.token: ERC-20 (must be allowlisted on the receiver).

returns.tba: Always address(0) in this iteration; reserved for                    the collection-side TBA leg follow-up.

mintAgentWithSVG(string,string).details: Free path — mirrors {registerAgentWithRoyalty} but with         the OnChainSVG mode lock. Paid + allowlist variants can         be added in a follow-up; the canonical generative-drop         flow is the BaseURI path of {mintAgent}.

royaltyInfo(uint256,uint256).details: Returns how much royalty is owed and to whom, based on a sale price that may be denominated in any unit of exchange. The royalty amount is denominated and should be paid in that same unit of exchange.

params.endTime_: Unix timestamp when allowlist phase ends and public mint begins. 0 = no end (allowlist forever).
params.maxPerWallet_: Per-wallet cap during allowlist phase (0 = unlimited)
params.root_: Merkle root over keccak256(abi.encodePacked(addr)) leaves. Pass bytes32(0) to disable.

setRoyaltyReceiverOnce(address).details: Once set, the value is immutable. The splitter becomes the         destination for primary mint revenue, contractURI fee_recipient,         and ERC-2981 royalty receiver. Governance (hooks, mint config,         lock) stays with collectionCreator.

returns.author: keccak256 of canonical author identity (Layer 2)
returns.contractName: canonical name of this contract (Layer 3 input)
returns.magic: steganographic magic baked in deployment bytecode (Layer 3)

VIMS_LICENSE().notice: keccak256("MIT") — license under which this code is published.

activeHookFor(uint256).notice: Hook currently active for a given agent (per-agent override > collection-wide).

collectionHook().notice: Collection-wide hook applied to every token unless an agent-level         override is configured via {hookOf}. Set with {setCollectionHook}.

commitEvolution(uint256,bytes32,(bool,st.notice: Apply a hook result that was computed off-chain by the authorised keeper.

commitNonce(uint256).notice: Monotonic per-agent nonce protecting `commitEvolution` against replay.

evolutionKeeper().notice: Off-chain compute keeper authorized to submit signed `commitEvolution` results.

evolutionStateHash(uint256).notice: Latest off-chain state hash committed for an agent (0 → never evolved).

hookOf(uint256).notice: Per-agent hook override. Takes precedence over {collectionHook}.

hookPermissions(address).notice: Cached permissions bitset for an active hook (collection-wide or per-agent).         Reduces external `permissions()` calls during the hot mint/transfer path.

isAllowlisted(address,bytes32[]).notice: Verify a merkle proof for an address against the allowlist root

mintAgent(string,string).notice: Mint an agent with payment (protocol fee automatically collected)

mintAgentAllowlist(string,string,bytes32.notice: Mint during the allowlist phase by submitting a merkle proof

mintAgentWithFullStack(string,string,byt.notice: Atomic mint + x402 service register. Same payment + supply +         allowlist gating as `mintAgent`, plus an optional service-         registration leg. Reverts if the allowlist phase is still         active — mirrors `mintAgent`.

mintAgentWithSVG(string,string).notice: Mint an agent and atomically commit its on-chain SVG.         The token's metadata mode is locked to `OnChainSVG`;         post-mint mutation is restricted to the same mode via         {setSVGImage}.

serviceRoyaltyOf(uint256).notice: {IAgentNFTAdapter} adapter view — collection-level financial         recipient + per-token service royalty bps. Matches the         {IAgentNFTAdapter} ABI by selector; the interface is NOT in         the inheritance tree because doing so forces a diamond-         resolution `ownerOf` override that bloats bytecode without         improving ABI compatibility.

setAllowlistConfig(bytes32,uint256,uint2.notice: Configure the merkle allowlist phase (creator only)

setBaseURI(string).notice: Set the shared metadata base URI for this collection.         When set, any token minted with an empty `agentURI` resolves         its `tokenURI` to `string.concat(baseURI, tokenId, ".json")`.         Pre-existing tokens with an explicit `_tokenURI` are not         affected. Creator-only; pass an empty string to clear.

setCollectionHook(address).notice: Set the collection-wide hook (creator only). Pass address(0) to clear.

setEvolutionKeeper(address).notice: Authorise an off-chain compute keeper for `commitEvolution` (creator only).

setHook(uint256,address).notice: Set / clear a per-agent hook override (token owner only).

setRoyaltyReceiverOnce(address).notice: Wire the per-collection royalty splitter exactly once. Callable         only by the deploying factory immediately after proxy init.

triggerEvolve(uint256,bytes32,bytes).notice: Permissionless trigger entry point. The active hook decides whether         to mutate. If the hook declares FLAG_REQUIRES_KEEPER (or returns         requiresKeeper=true), host emits EvolutionRequested and waits for         a signed `commitEvolution` from the keeper.

vimsAttest().notice: Pure attestation function that defeats dead-code elimination on         the steganographic constants. Anyone (off-chain) can call this         to verify the bytecode they hold matches a canonical VIMS build.

vimsProvenance().notice: Returns the full VIMS provenance block for this contract.
